import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
plt.xkcd()
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8,5))
ax.set_xlim(0,10); ax.set_ylim(0,6); ax.set_aspect('equal'); ax.axis('off')
ax.set_title('Solar array + battery for cold room')
# cold room
ax.text(7,5.2,'cold room',fontsize=10)
import matplotlib.patches as mp
ax.add_patch(mp.Rectangle((6,2.5),3,2.5,color='lightblue'))
ax.text(6.3,1.8,'battery+MPPT',fontsize=9)
ax.add_patch(mp.Rectangle((6.3,1.0),1.5,0.7,color='gold'))
# panels
for i,x in enumerate([1,2.5,4]):
    ax.plot([x,x+1.2],[3.2,4.0],'k-',lw=2)
    ax.plot([x,x+1.2],[3.2,3.2],'k-')
    ax.text(x,2.6,f'550W {i+1}',fontsize=8)
ax.annotate('sun',xy=(2.5,4.5),xytext=(2.5,5.3),arrowprops=dict(facecolor='orange'),fontsize=12,ha='center')
ax.annotate('cable to cold room',xy=(6,2),xytext=(3.5,1.2),arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->'),fontsize=9)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.savefig('sketch.png',dpi=150)
